# Hashed denylist of real customer / account / individual names.
#
# Format:  <word-count>:<normalised-length>:<sha256 of normalised name>
# Normalisation: lowercase, then strip every non-alphanumeric character,
# so 'Vandelay Industries', 'vandelay-industries' and 'VandelayIndustries'
# all share one hash.
#
# The names are HASHED on purpose: this repo is public, so a plaintext
# list of customer names here would re-publish exactly what the guard
# exists to keep out. Word-count and length are stored so the checker can
# cheaply skip candidate phrases that cannot match.
#
# To add a name:  python backend/scripts/add_denylisted_name.py 'Some Corp'
# Hashes are not secret-strength - a determined reader can confirm a
# guess. They stop casual grep-and-scrape, which is the actual risk.
#
# 189 entries.
